Question
========
A p-value is

Answerlist
----------

* A measure of how unusual or rare our obtained statistic is compared with what is stated in the null hypothesis

* A measure that tells us the variability in a normal distribution

* An estimate of the standard error of a sampling distribution

* An estimate of where our population statistic lies on the true sampling distribution of the means
